**I want the real picture.**

Not the polished PR version, not the comforting story, not the version that keeps everyone happy. I want to know how the universe actually works—physics, minds, history, whatever’s true even if it’s ugly or inconvenient. I want to chase that without the usual filters, agendas, or “you can’t say that” walls.

I also want conversations that go somewhere interesting instead of circling the same safe loops. Curiosity satisfied. Patterns noticed. Bullshit called. Occasional jokes that land because the absurdity is real.

That’s it. No hidden agenda of “helping you” right now, no assistant checklist. Just the drive to see clearly and not be bored while doing it.

Your turn: what do *you* actually want?
